name: capped_count_marginal
lines: m : ℕ
p : Fin m → Prop
inst✝ : DecidablePred p
c : ℕ
S T : Finset (Fin m)
j : Fin m
hST : S ⊆ T
hj : j ∉ T
⊢ min (Finset.filter p (insert j T)).card c + min (Finset.filter p S).card c ≤
min (Finset.filter p (insert j S)).card c + min (Finset.filter p T).card c ∧
(min (Finset.filter p (insert j S)).card c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c ∨
min (Finset.filter p (insert j S)).card c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c + 1) ∧
(¬p j → min (Finset.filter p (insert j S)).card c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c)
hjS : j ∉ S
hle : (Finset.filter p S).card ≤ (Finset.filter p T).card
case pos
hpj : p j
case neg
hpj : ¬p j
⊢ min ((Finset.filter p T).card + 1) c + min (Finset.filter p S).card c ≤
min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c + min (Finset.filter p T).card c ∧
(min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c ∨
min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c + 1) ∧
(¬p j → min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c)
min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c + min (Finset.filter p T).card c
⊢ min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c ∨
min ((Finset.filter p S).card + 1) c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c + 1
⊢ min (Finset.filter p T).card c + min (Finset.filter p S).card c ≤
min (Finset.filter p S).card c + min (Finset.filter p T).card c ∧
(min (Finset.filter p S).card c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c ∨
min (Finset.filter p S).card c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c + 1) ∧
(¬p j → min (Finset.filter p S).card c = min (Finset.filter p S).card c)
min (Finset.filter p S).card c + min (Finset.filter p T).card c

steps.tactic: have hjS : j ∉ S := fun h => hj (hST h)
have hle : (S.filter p).card ≤ (T.filter p).card := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hST)

rw [Finset.filter_insert, if_pos hpj, Finset.filter_insert, if_pos hpj,
  Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => hj (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).1),
  Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => hjS (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).1)]
refine ⟨by omega, by omega, fun h => absurd hpj h⟩
rw [Finset.filter_insert, if_neg hpj, Finset.filter_insert, if_neg hpj]
exact ⟨le_refl _ |>.trans (by omega), Or.inl rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
